description: Comprehensive accessibility accommodations and adaptive strategies for daily living

items.title: High Contrast Mode
items.description: Enable high contrast display settings on all devices to improve text readability and reduce eye strain.

items.title: Screen Reader Setup
items.description: Configure a screen reader like NVDA, JAWS, or VoiceOver to navigate digital content through audio feedback.

items.title: Text-to-Speech for Documents
items.description: Use text-to-speech software to have documents, emails, and web content read aloud.

items.title: Magnification Tools
items.description: Set up screen magnification software or use built-in zoom features to enlarge content on screen.

items.title: Color Blind Filters
items.description: Apply color blind accessibility filters to distinguish colors that might otherwise appear similar.

items.title: Audio Description Settings
items.description: Enable audio descriptions for movies, TV shows, and video content to understand visual elements.

items.title: Braille Display Connection
items.description: Connect and configure a refreshable Braille display for tactile reading of digital content.

items.title: Voice Assistant Integration
items.description: Set up voice assistants like Siri, Alexa, or Google Assistant for hands-free device control.

items.title: Closed Captions Everywhere
items.description: Enable closed captions on all streaming services, social media, and video platforms.

items.title: Live Transcription Apps
items.description: Use apps like Live Transcribe or Otter.ai to convert spoken words to text in real-time.

items.title: Visual Alerts Setup
items.description: Configure devices to flash lights or vibrate for notifications, alarms, and doorbells.

items.title: Video Relay Services
items.description: Register for video relay services to make phone calls using sign language interpreters.

items.title: Hearing Loop Compatibility
items.description: Check hearing aids for T-coil compatibility to use with hearing loops in public venues.

items.title: Bluetooth Hearing Aids
items.description: Connect Bluetooth-enabled hearing aids directly to phones and TVs for clearer audio.

items.title: Sign Language Learning
items.description: Learn basic sign language through apps like SignSchool or The ASL App for communication.

items.title: Sound Amplifier Apps
items.description: Use smartphone sound amplifier apps to boost and clarify environmental sounds.

items.title: Voice Control Navigation
items.description: Enable voice control on devices to navigate, type, and interact without physical touch.

items.title: Switch Access Configuration
items.description: Set up switch access controls for users who cannot use standard touch or mouse input.

items.title: Eye Tracking Setup
items.description: Configure eye tracking technology for cursor control and device navigation.

items.title: Keyboard Navigation Mastery
items.description: Learn keyboard shortcuts to navigate without a mouse using Tab, Enter, and arrow keys.

items.title: Adaptive Mouse Settings
items.description: Adjust mouse sensitivity, cursor size, and click speed for easier physical control.

items.title: One-Handed Keyboard Layouts
items.description: Enable one-handed keyboard layouts for typing with a single hand on mobile devices.

items.title: Dictation Software
items.description: Use dictation software like Dragon NaturallySpeaking for hands-free writing and computer control.

items.title: Smart Home Automation
items.description: Set up smart home devices to control lights, locks, and appliances without physical movement.

items.title: Simplified Interface Mode
items.description: Enable simplified or easy modes on devices to reduce visual clutter and complexity.

items.title: Reading Mode Activation
items.description: Use browser reading modes to strip away ads and distractions from web articles.

items.title: Text Formatting Preferences
items.description: Adjust font size, line spacing, and font type (like OpenDyslexic) for easier reading.

items.title: Focus Mode Settings
items.description: Enable Do Not Disturb and focus modes to minimize interruptions during tasks.

items.title: Task Breakdown Apps
items.description: Use apps that break complex tasks into smaller, manageable steps with visual progress.

items.title: Visual Schedule Creation
items.description: Create visual schedules with pictures and icons instead of text-only calendars.

items.title: Memory Aid Reminders
items.description: Set up multiple reminder systems across devices for important tasks and appointments.

items.title: Reduced Motion Settings
items.description: Disable animations and motion effects that can be distracting or cause discomfort.

items.title: Adjustable Desk Setup
items.description: Configure a sit-stand desk at proper heights for comfortable working positions.

items.title: Ergonomic Keyboard Placement
items.description: Position keyboard and mouse at elbow height with wrists in neutral position.

items.title: Monitor Height Adjustment
items.description: Set monitor top at eye level and arm's length away to reduce neck strain.

items.title: Lighting Optimization
items.description: Adjust room lighting to reduce glare on screens and prevent eye fatigue.

items.title: Wheelchair Accessible Workspace
items.description: Ensure desk height and clearance accommodate wheelchair access comfortably.

items.title: Grab Bar Installation
items.description: Install grab bars in bathrooms and high-traffic areas for stability support.

items.title: Non-Slip Surface Application
items.description: Apply non-slip mats and strips in wet areas and on stairs to prevent falls.

items.title: Lever Handle Replacement
items.description: Replace round doorknobs with lever handles for easier operation with limited grip.

items.title: AAC App Setup
items.description: Configure augmentative and alternative communication apps for non-verbal communication.

items.title: Symbol Communication Boards
items.description: Create physical or digital communication boards with picture symbols for quick messages.

items.title: Speech Generating Device
items.description: Set up and customize speech generating devices for text-to-speech communication.

items.title: Predictive Text Optimization
items.description: Train predictive text to learn frequently used phrases and vocabulary.

items.title: Quick Phrase Shortcuts
items.description: Set up text shortcuts for common phrases to reduce typing effort.

items.title: Translation App for Sign Language
items.description: Use apps that translate text or speech to sign language animations.

items.title: Email Templates
items.description: Create email and message templates for common communication scenarios.

items.title: Voice Banking
items.description: Record and bank your voice for use with speech generating devices if needed later.

items.title: Noise-Canceling Headphones
items.description: Use noise-canceling headphones to reduce overwhelming environmental sounds.

items.title: Weighted Blanket Use
items.description: Use a weighted blanket for deep pressure input to promote calm and focus.

items.title: Fidget Tool Collection
items.description: Keep various fidget tools available for sensory regulation during focus tasks.

items.title: Blue Light Filtering
items.description: Enable blue light filters on devices or use blue light blocking glasses.

items.title: Sensory Break Schedule
items.description: Schedule regular sensory breaks throughout the day to prevent overload.

items.title: Texture-Friendly Clothing
items.description: Choose seamless, tagless clothing in comfortable textures to reduce sensory irritation.

items.title: Scent-Free Zone
items.description: Create scent-free environments by using unscented products and air purifiers.

items.title: Sunglasses Indoors Permission
items.description: Use tinted glasses or sunglasses indoors when lighting is overwhelming.

items.title: Visual Timer Use
items.description: Use visual timers to see time passing and understand duration of tasks.

items.title: Time Blocking Method
items.description: Assign specific time blocks to different activities with buffer time between.

items.title: Transition Warnings
items.description: Set multiple alarms before activity transitions to prepare for changes.

items.title: Energy Level Tracking
items.description: Track energy patterns to schedule demanding tasks during peak energy times.

items.title: Automatic Scheduling
items.description: Use AI scheduling tools that automatically optimize your calendar around energy and preferences.

items.title: Pomodoro Technique Adaptation
items.description: Modify Pomodoro intervals to match your attention span and break needs.

items.title: Calendar Color Coding
items.description: Use consistent colors for different activity types in digital calendars.

items.title: Routine Anchoring
items.description: Attach new habits to existing routines using anchor points throughout the day.

items.title: Browser Extension Setup
items.description: Install accessibility browser extensions for enhanced web browsing experience.

items.title: Accessibility Shortcuts Learning
items.description: Learn built-in accessibility keyboard shortcuts for your operating system.

items.title: Document Accessibility Check
items.description: Run accessibility checkers on documents before sharing to ensure compatibility.

items.title: Alt Text Settings
items.description: Enable image descriptions and alt text display in social media and browsers.

items.title: PDF Accessibility Tools
items.description: Use tools to make PDFs accessible with proper reading order and tags.

items.title: Video Playback Controls
items.description: Use video players with speed control, rewind, and subtitle customization.

items.title: Password Manager Setup
items.description: Use a password manager to reduce memory load and simplify logins.

items.title: Cloud Sync Everything
items.description: Enable cloud sync across devices so content is always accessible anywhere.

items.title: Communication Card Creation
items.description: Create cards explaining your access needs to show in social situations.

items.title: Script Preparation
items.description: Prepare scripts for common social interactions like ordering food or phone calls.

items.title: Exit Strategy Planning
items.description: Plan exit strategies before social events including signals and transportation.

items.title: Quiet Space Identification
items.description: Identify quiet spaces in venues before events for sensory breaks.

items.title: Buddy System Setup
items.description: Arrange a buddy for events who understands your needs and can assist.

items.title: Energy Budget Planning
items.description: Plan social activities based on available energy with built-in recovery time.

items.title: Virtual Attendance Option
items.description: Request virtual attendance options for meetings and events when needed.

items.title: Accessibility Request Template
items.description: Create a template for requesting accommodations at events and venues.

items.title: Emergency Contact Card
items.description: Create a card with emergency contacts, medical info, and communication needs.

items.title: Medical ID Setup
items.description: Set up Medical ID on smartphone accessible from lock screen.

items.title: Visual Emergency Guide
items.description: Create visual guides for emergency procedures in picture format.

items.title: Sensory Emergency Kit
items.description: Pack an emergency kit with sensory tools, headphones, sunglasses, and fidgets.

items.title: Location Sharing Setup
items.description: Enable location sharing with trusted contacts for safety tracking.

items.title: Backup Power Planning
items.description: Keep portable chargers and backup batteries for essential assistive devices.

items.title: Alternative Communication Plan
items.description: Plan backup communication methods if primary AAC or devices fail.

items.title: Medication Management System
items.description: Set up pill organizers with alarms and backup supplies for emergencies.

items.title: Recording Permission Request
items.description: Request permission to record lectures and meetings for later review.

items.title: Extended Time Documentation
items.description: Document and request extended time for tests and assignments.

items.title: Note-Taking Support
items.description: Arrange for note-takers, shared notes, or lecture recordings.

items.title: Alternative Format Materials
items.description: Request learning materials in accessible formats like audio, large print, or digital.

items.title: Preferential Seating
items.description: Arrange seating near front, exits, or quiet areas based on needs.

items.title: Break Time Allowance
items.description: Request permission for sensory or rest breaks during long sessions.

items.title: Assignment Breakdown Help
items.description: Request syllabi and assignment breakdowns in advance for planning.

items.title: Quiet Testing Environment
items.description: Arrange for separate, quiet testing spaces to reduce distraction.

items.title: Flexible Schedule Request
items.description: Request flexible work hours or schedule adjustments based on energy patterns.

items.title: Remote Work Setup
items.description: Request and optimize remote work arrangements with proper equipment.

items.title: Job Coaching Support
items.description: Arrange for job coaching or workplace support services if available.

items.title: Accommodation Documentation
items.description: Document all workplace accommodations formally with HR for protection.
